title_en: DON BOSCO, APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+PARKING SPACE!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment together with a parking stall on the -2nd floor. The residence is located on Don Bosco Street, near Fiori Di Bosco. The surface is 117.7m2 and is organized in a living room together with the kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom. The apartment also has a parking space included in the price. The area is favorable and offers you every possible facility. For more information contact us!
